Analytics Engineer — Data Platform Team
Northwind Retail Group, Singapore

About the role
You will own the SQL models that power reporting and experimentation across the company.

What you will do
- Design, build and maintain the dbt models behind our core reporting marts
- Ship and maintain BI dashboards used by leadership and operations teams
- Partner with product and marketing on experiment analysis and metric definitions

What we are looking for
- 3+ years writing analytics SQL and building data models on a cloud warehouse (Snowflake or BigQuery)
- Production experience with dbt, including tests, documentation and CI checks
- Experience building and owning BI dashboards in Looker or Tableau
- Hands-on experience scheduling and monitoring pipelines with Airflow
- Ability to design and analyze A/B experiments end to end
- Clear written and verbal communication with non-technical stakeholders
- Working knowledge of Python for data transformation and automation
- Comfortable with Git-based development workflows and code review

resume.sourceText:
PRIYA NAIR
Senior Analytics Engineer — 6 years of SQL and data modelling experience

EDUCATION
BSc Statistics, Nanyang Technological University, 2019.

EXPERIENCE
Senior Analytics Engineer, Finch Commerce (2022-present)
- Led the dbt migration across 40+ models, adding tests, docs and CI checks to every mart
- Built the company's Looker instance from scratch, now serving 120 weekly active viewers
- Modelled order, payments and logistics marts in Snowflake SQL used by finance and ops
- Ran a weekly metrics review with the heads of finance and operations
- Helped a product manager define success metrics for one pricing A/B test

Analytics Engineer, Grabble (2019-2022)
- Wrote and maintained BigQuery SQL models for marketing attribution reporting
- Automated recurring reporting jobs with Python scripts scheduled via cron

SKILLS
SQL (Snowflake, BigQuery), dbt (tests, docs, CI), Looker, Python, Git and GitHub pull-request review
